[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra IV.12 (Kaivalyapāda) — Atītānāgataṃ svarūpato'styadhvabhedāddharmāṇām | Pages 711-713]

ataś ca
phalasya nimittaṃ vartamānī-karaṇe samarthaṃ na–apūrva-upajanane / Siddhaṃ nimittaṃ
naimittikasya viśeṣa-anugrahaṃ kurute, na–apūrvam utpādayati–iti / Dharmī ca–aneka-
dharma-svabhāvaḥ / Tasya ca–adhva-bhedena dharmāḥ pratyavasthitāḥ / Na ca yathā
vartamānaṃ vyakti-viśeṣa-āpannaṃ dravyato'sty evam atītam anāgataṃ ca / Kathaṃ tarhi ?
svena–eva vyaṅgyena svarūpeṇa–anāgatam asti svena ca–anubhūta-vyaktikena svarūpeṇa–
atītam iti / Vartamānasya–eva–adhvanaḥ svarūpa-vyaktir iti / Na sā bhavaty–atīta-
anāgatayor adhvanor ekasya ca–adhvanaḥ samaye dvāv adhvānau dharmi-samanvāgatau
bhavata eva–iti na–abhūtvā bhāvas trayāṇām adhvānām iti /12/
L'anāgata 'non [encore] survenu' est ce dont la manifestation est future. L'atīta
'survenu' est ce
